messages:
Sara (Sales): Hey team — ClearSky Health is ready to sign the POC order. Legal pushed back on a few DPA clauses and requested Net-60 on the invoice. Can we map the signature path and confirm billing? PO attached: https://docs.example.com/po/CSH-PO-442

Mike (Legal): Thanks. Quick notes: 1) We can't accept Net-60 for POCs without exec approval; propose Net-30 and prepay option. 2) DPA redlines: limited liability cap, data deletion timeline (30 -> 60 days), and subprocessor list — we can accept deletion 45 days max. I'll paste redlined snippet in a sec.

Anika (PS): POC runs 4w, target start 5/10. Customer wants private VPC + KMS. Onboarding needs access by SRE team and a trimmed SOW for sign-off.

Jorge (Eng): Confirmed we can support KMS + VPC for the POC. Need customer KMS ARN and CIDR for peering. Also, KV cache behavior will be standard — no model training.

Nina (Finance): If we move to Net-30 we need vendor onboarding (W-9 + bank details). They asked about EDI — do they require PO number on invoice? If yes, include `PO: 442-210`.

Sara (Sales): @Mike can legal accept deletion 45 days? Also who's the right signee on their side — procurement or CIO? They listed "Director of Platform" as approver.

Mike (Legal): 45 days is reasonable for a POC. For signatories: procurement signs orderform, exec (CIO) signs MSA only if exceeding X spend. For a POC keep MSA signature optional — countersign after orderform.

deploy-bot: docu-sign envelope created by Sara (Sales): envelope_id=env_00977 link=https://ds.example.com/env/env_00977

Sara (Sales): Created order form in DocuSign with procurement as primary signer and legal for cc. @Nina please confirm invoice settings (PO on invoice + Net-30) so I can update orderform fields.

Nina (Finance): Confirm PO # 442-210 and Net-30. Billing = invoice on start of POC. Add vendor remittance email: ap@redwood.com.

Anika (PS): I'll prep the concise SOW and checklist for onboarding (KMS ARN, CIDR, point-of-contact + SLAs). Suggest we add a 99.9% POC uptime clause and rollback plan.

Mike (Legal): I'll upload the redline summary to the thread and mark the DPA with accepted changes. Action: legal to sign after procurement signs order form unless additional MSA terms are requested by customer.

Jorge (Eng): FYI: If customer enables strong encryption / bring-your-own-keys we'll require 24-48h extra for networking + certs. Flagging as potential blocker for start date.

Sara (Sales): Action items: 1) @Nina set invoice with PO and Net-30 2) @Anika send SOW + onboarding checklist to customer today 3) @Mike finalize DPA redlines and confirm sign order 4) @Jorge provide networking checklist. I'll follow up once DocuSign envelope is out. :thumbsup:

Mike (Legal): ACK. I'll review and sign once procurement completes their step.

Nina (Finance): Will do. ETA EOD today to confirm billing fields.

Sara (Sales): Thanks all — will ping customer to expect DocuSign and onboarding questionnaire. Closing loop in this thread when signed.
